name: U-Haul Holding Company
moat_justification: Dominant DIY moving network — 24,000+ locations, >50% DIY share, a fleet larger than the top three rivals combined and the #3 self-storage operator in North America — but a capital-intensive, price-compared rental business whose measured returns have eroded: the ROIC proxy fell from 24.5% (FY2017) to 2.2% (FY2026) and operating margin from 21.7% to 7.2% over the same span (fundamentals.json), so the network moat is real but is no longer earning wide-moat returns.
fragility_flags: BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (filed 2026-05-27, accession 0001193125-26-241850), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-6): the operating-activities reconciliation for FY2026, FY2025 and FY2024 is enumerated in full (depreciation $1,183,133k / $971,933k / $817,889k, premium amortization, debt-issuance amortization, interest credited to policyholders, disposal gains/losses, deferred taxes and working-capital changes) with no share-based or stock-based compensation line anywhere in it, and the listed items reconcile exactly to the reported operating cash flow ($1,794,584k / $1,454,429k / $1,452,756k) with no SBC addback. The terms 'share-based' and 'stock-based' appear nowhere in the filing, EDGAR companyfacts carries no ShareBasedCompensation or AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense fact for CIK 4457 in any year, and weighted average shares were flat at 196,077,880 combined throughout FY2024-FY2026.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (filed 2026-05-27, accession 0001193125-26-241850), Note 4 Earnings Per Share (pp. F-17/F-18) and the Consolidated Statements of Operations: weighted average shares outstanding are stated on a 'Basic and diluted' basis for both classes — Voting Common Stock 19,607,788 plus Series N Non-Voting Common Stock 176,470,092 equals a total of 196,077,880 — with the identical total for FY2026, FY2025 and FY2024; EPS is computed under the two-class method with basic and diluted the same.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
one_liner: Dominant moving-and-storage network, moat 5/10, but no positive conservative owner's earnings at any point in the last 5 years — fleet capex swallows operating cash flow (base OE -$7.85/share, latest FY -$6.93/share), so Tier F at $57.02; it clears no hurdle on this model and even the maintenance definition (FY2026 OE $83,128k) is under 1% of the $11.18B market cap.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Location density no rival matches: 24,000+ rental locations (company stores + independent dealers) vs roughly 2,500 for Penske — convenience is the purchase criterion in DIY moving
Scale: a fleet of approximately 207,600 trucks, larger than the top three competitors combined, and over 50% share of the DIY self-moving market
Brand default since 1945 — U-Haul is the generic name for a rental truck, feeding direct and app demand (Truck Share 24/7 self-dispatch)
Self-storage flywheel: #3 operator in North America (about 100.3M sq ft) attached to the moving funnel; storage revenue +8.3% in FY2026 with revenue per occupied foot rising
Dealer network expands reach on other people's capital; vertical integration (fleet manufacturing/repair, propane retail, hitch installation) supports availability and cost
moat_against: Measured returns contradict a wide moat: ROIC proxy 24.5% (FY2017) to 2.2% (FY2026) and operating margin 17.4% to 7.2% in the last two fiscal years alone (fundamentals.json)
Commodity, price-compared purchase: customers rent on price and proximity with zero switching cost; Penske, Avis Budget and Enterprise contest every market
Capital intensity: fleet and storage capex ($3,154,325k in FY2026, 10-K cash-flow statement) runs at roughly 2.7x depreciation — the network must be continuously re-bought

Post-COVID over-expansion: FY2026 fleet depreciation rose $186.6M and disposal losses were $117.6M (FY2026 results release); management says new storage units are still completing faster than they fill (Q1 FY2027 release)

Shoen-family control and a related-party web ($114.1M of related-party costs in FY2026, 10-K) plus leverage — notes, loans and finance leases payable of $8,083,374k against $1,120,147k of cash at March 31, 2026 — limit minority-holder recourse and flexibility
